baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا ... يَعْلَمُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The sufficiency verb makes God completely meet the evidentiary need; doubled bayna locates the witness in the disputed interval, while presence, knowledgeable declaration, and knowing bind observation to judgment.

activation_trace.role: Standing for an affair until sufficiency makes the witness adequate to the whole dispute.
The middle or interval between parties supplies the witness's relational position.
Presence with direct observation makes testimony more than secondhand report.
A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the adjudicative function.
Disclosure of the matter to the knower grounds the witness's competence.

changed_reading.before: God is invoked as one witness among possible proofs.
changed_reading.after: God occupies the interval between the parties and alone completes the evidentiary requirement because presence and total knowledge coincide in this witness.

baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah does not oppose belief to no belief. It depicts trust and heart-settling assent invested in what lacks truth and stability, while God is covered or denied; the result is depletion of the believer's own capital.

activation_trace.role: Security, confidence, and entrusted reliance make belief an investment of safety.
Heart-settling assent supplies the positive act that can be attached to a false object.
Departure from truth and stability makes the trusted object unable to bear reliance.
Covering supplies the inverse act: concealing the ground that could actually secure trust.
Commercial loss renders the outcome as capital placed where no return can hold.

changed_reading.before: The closing labels people as unbelievers who are generically ruined.
changed_reading.after: They are active believers whose trust is misallocated to an unstable asset while its true guarantor is covered, so their ruin is self-depleting investment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The commanded saying is not merely a container for information. Saying externalizes the claim, bayna discloses and differentiates the parties, and the tongue-witness branch lets the utterance itself become a public evidentiary act.

activation_trace.role: Voicing brings the claim out into public articulation.
A thing's 'saying' as its indication lets the utterance function as evidence, not only speech.
Disclosure through speech or sign turns the interval into an exposed distinction.
The tongue as witness makes the commanded statement perform testimony.

changed_reading.before: Qul simply introduces a proposition about a remote witness.
changed_reading.after: The commanded utterance publicly stages the dispute, differentiates its parties, and participates in the testimony it announces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence makes 'we believe' a spoken claim that is not left untested: trial assays it, divine knowing distinguishes enacted truth from lie, and 29:52 then identifies a belief whose very object is false. Witnessing therefore reads as verified discrimination, not passive omniscience.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent anchors the changed reading in the focus ayah's object-directed belief.
Voiced saying makes 'we believe' an inspectable claim.
The same assent branch supplies the claimed state before testing.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the verification operation.
Repeated disclosure to the knower turns the assay into a discriminating witness-process.
Truth realized in deed supplies the successful assay result.
Contradiction of truth supplies the failed result against which the claim is known.

structural_cues: 29:2 encloses the formula 'we believe' between saying and testing.
29:3 repeats divine knowing on the two outcomes, those who made truth real and the liars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, assay, repeated knowing, and truth/lie outcomes; I infer that trial operationalizes witness and exposes what a belief is actually attached to. A live alternative is that the sequence tests fidelity under pressure rather than the truth-value of the believed object.

changed_reading.before: Those who believe in falsehood simply chose the wrong proposition.
changed_reading.after: Their belief is a claim and attachment that fails the surah's assay: divine witness exposes whether confessed trust becomes truth-bearing action or remains attached to falsity.

context_deltas.mechanism: False guidance is offered as a liability-transfer scheme: follow our path and we will guarantee your errors. The guarantee is denied, burdens remain with their owners and compound, and invented assurances become grounds for questioning. Focus loss thereby acquires a debt-and-liability mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Lack of truth and stability anchors the invalid guarantee in the focus ayah.
Trading loss makes the failed guarantee legible as accumulated liability.
Following behind supplies the induced commitment to the offered path.
Surety and guarantee supply the promised transfer of responsibility.
Sin supplies the purportedly transferable liability.
Contradiction of truth marks the guarantee as fraudulent.
Bearing trust or guilt returns responsibility to the actual bearer.
Weight and measure turn wrongdoing into liabilities that can accumulate but not be wished away.
Fabricated falsehood identifies the sales pitch that adds further burden.

structural_cues: 29:12 offers to carry another's errors and immediately negates the offer.
29:13 triples the burden term, adds burdens alongside burdens, and ends with questioning over fabrication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solicitation, a false guarantee, nontransferable guilt, compounded loads, and fabrication; I infer a bad-credit mechanism in which false belief is socially underwritten and loss is retained liability. The narrower alternative is ordinary deception with no economic coloring.

changed_reading.before: The losers suffer an unspecified final deficit for false belief.
changed_reading.after: Their loss includes accepting or marketing an impossible indemnity: accountability cannot be transferred, and the false assurance itself compounds the load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same between-space that holds God's witness can hold an idol-mediated bond. Worldly affection makes false worship a social adhesive, but that bond reverses into mutual repudiation and expulsion; loss is the collapse of the relationship infrastructure that the false object sustained.

activation_trace.role: A connection standing between parties anchors the focus dispute as a relational field.
Repudiation and disavowal supply the reversal latent in focus denial.
General diminishment makes broken solidarity part of the focus loss.
The worshipped image supplies the false object's concrete social center.
Love and affection supply the bond maintained by that center.
The explicitly inter-party connection maps that affection onto the focus ayah's doubled interval.
Mutual disavowal reverses the earlier social bond.
Expulsion under anger makes the bond's terminal separation visible.

structural_cues: 29:25 moves from affection between the group in worldly life to each party repudiating and cursing the other.
The focus ayah repeats bayna but places the sufficient witness, rather than the idol, in that interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies idol, affection, between-space, mutual repudiation, and expulsion; I infer that the false object functions as social infrastructure whose collapse is adjudicated in 29:52. A live alternative is that affection merely accompanies worship rather than causing it.

changed_reading.before: Belief in falsehood is an isolated individual's intellectual error.
changed_reading.after: It can be a social contract: a false center binds people together temporarily, then the bond inverts into mutual disavowal, making lost belonging part of khusr.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider-house sequence converts abstract misplaced belief into failed shelter engineering. Chosen protectors promise nearness and aid, but the woven dwelling has no load-bearing strength; knowing and reason read the parable, while creation in truth supplies the stable contrast.

activation_trace.role: Security and reliance anchor the shelter reading in the focus act of belief.
Lack of truth and stability names why the trusted shelter cannot hold.
Diminishment supplies the collapse suffered by the one who inhabits the weak structure.
Love, alliance, and aid supply the protective relation being outsourced.
The weaving creature supplies a visibly constructed but misleading support system.
Dwelling and shelter make reliance spatial and load-bearing.
Loss of strength identifies the shelter's structural failure.
Calling or drawing by speech identifies the attachments God knows beneath the shelter claim.
The parable as admonitory sign authorizes transfer from house mechanics to belief.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the capacity to detect false support.
Reality-stable truth supplies the direct opposite of batil's non-load-bearing condition.

structural_cues: 29:41 repeats house three times and places comparative weakness at the center of a protector analogy.
29:42-43 frame the analogy with divine knowing and human comprehension; 29:44 immediately joins heavens and earth to truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protectors, a woven house, weakness, knowing, a parabolic sign, reason, and reality-stable truth; I infer that entrusting oneself to a protector is functionally inhabiting its shelter. The alternative is a narrower critique of powerlessness without a claim about felt security.

changed_reading.before: Believing in falsehood means assenting to something unreal.
changed_reading.after: It means moving one's security into a constructed shelter whose apparent network conceals structural weakness; divine knowledge sees the actual load-bearing condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in assembles a provenance and sufficiency chain: prior recitation or writing would have opened doubt to nullifiers, the present signs are clear, the recited book already suffices as mercy and reminder, and only then is God named sufficient witness. The witness certifies existing evidence rather than compensating for its absence.

activation_trace.role: Complete adequacy anchors the final witness in the focus ayah.
Knowledge-grounded declaration supplies certification rather than a substitute exhibit.
Following in ordered recitation supplies the counterfactual provenance issue.
Written letters and book form the documentary object whose prior possession is denied.
Agitated doubt identifies the evidentiary opening that the provenance fact closes.
Making false claims identifies the party that would exploit such doubt.
Visible signs supply affirmative evidence after the counterfactual is closed.
Manifest clarity makes the signs evidentially disclosed.
The repeated sufficiency root explicitly joins book-adequacy to witness-adequacy.
The book is the sufficient documentary object already present.
Ongoing ordered recitation makes the exhibit publicly available.
Reminder gives the sufficient text a recollective function for receptive believers.

structural_cues: 29:48-49 move from a counterfactual source of doubt to clear signs held in knowledgeable breasts.
29:50 records a demand for additional signs; 29:51 answers with the sufficiency of the already recited book; 29:52 repeats sufficiency with God as witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a provenance defense, clear signs, a demand for more, recited-book sufficiency, and divine-witness sufficiency; I infer that the last certifies and closes the preceding evidence chain. A live alternative is that God's witness terminates the dispute independently of the book.

changed_reading.before: God's witness replaces the external signs that opponents requested.
changed_reading.after: The appeal is the capstone of a forensic chain: the recited text is already the public exhibit, and the all-knowing witness certifies its provenance and adequacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions make the opponents verbally concede who created and ordered the heavens and earth and who sends life-giving water, yet they are turned away and fail to bind that admission with reason. Their own saying becomes testimony inside the cosmic field that God knows.

activation_trace.role: The tongue-witness anchors the opponents' later speech as evidence against their reversal.
What is above and overshadows supplies one half of the total known field.
The lower realm opposite the sky completes that field.
Origination supplies the fact the speakers themselves concede.
The created heavens repeat the focus ayah's upper domain.
The created earth repeats the focus ayah's lower domain.
Subjection to an ordered purpose turns the cosmic pair into functional evidence.
Their voiced answer externalizes the concession.
Turning a thing from its direction supplies the move from acknowledged evidence to contrary allegiance.
Delivery downward joins the upper domain to the lower one.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the material connector.
Earth's life through rain makes the connector's effect publicly visible.
The fertile earth receives and displays the life-giving effect.
Their answer and the answering command place two voiced responses in contrast.
Reason as restraint from ignorance identifies the missing integration of conceded facts.

structural_cues: 29:61 repeats heavens and earth in a question whose answer is 'God,' then asks how the respondents are turned.
29:63 repeats the question-answer form with water descending from sky and reviving earth, then says most do not reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two elicited admissions, an ordered cosmos, a visible sky-to-earth life process, directional reversal, and failed reasoning; I infer that the speakers' own answers become witness evidence and that focus kufr is post-recognition reversal. The alternative is practical ingratitude without a stable prior cognitive concession.

changed_reading.before: God alone knows hidden cosmic facts that the deniers do not possess.
changed_reading.after: The known cosmos also elicits their own self-incriminating testimony: they name God as its source, then turn that acknowledged evidence away from its consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-closing reprise places the focus antithesis inside lived geography: a protected precinct is secure while people around it are snatched away, yet the beneficiaries trust falsehood and cover the blessing. Belief in batil is therefore misattribution of experienced safety, and loss is both epistemic and material misaccounting.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust anchor the reprise in the focus act of belief.
Lack of truth and stability identifies the false security-account.
Covering a benefit makes denial specifically an act of ingratitude.
Commercial loss frames the misattribution as bad accounting of received value.
A protected spatial precinct supplies the concrete container of safety.
One root joins the sanctuary's security to the beneficiaries' act of trusting.
Swift seizure outside the precinct exposes the contrast that makes its safety legible.
The surrounding direction organizes a secure center against a dangerous perimeter.
The exact falsehood object repeats the focus trust's unstable destination.
Beneficent good condition names what the secure community has actually received.
Covering the benefit exactly specifies the focus denial as ingratitude.

structural_cues: 29:67 repeats the focus pair 'believe in falsehood' and 'disbelieve in/cover' with the same objects in chiastic order.
The reprise first contrasts a secure center with people being seized from its perimeter, then names blessing as what is covered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual spatial safety, surrounding danger, the exact belief-falsehood pair, and covering of blessing; I infer that false trust miscredits the source of experienced security. The alternative is that sanctuary is one rhetorical instance of the broader focus category, not its defining mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Belief in falsehood and denial of God are abstract doctrinal opposites.
changed_reading.after: They include seeing real protection, accrediting safety to an unstable object or system, and covering the benefaction that the lived contrast itself makes visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's secondary ك ف ف mapping for كفى and on a material scale analogy. It remains anchored in كفى and الخاسرون through the containing scale-pan and short-measure branches; downstream prose should present it only as exploratory imagery, not as lexical equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The containing pan of a balance supplies a material image for sufficient adjudication.
Knowledge-grounded judgment supplies what is weighed in that image.
Short measure or deficient weighing makes the losers those who ultimately shortchange themselves.

changed_reading.before: Sufficiency and loss are unrelated clauses.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sufficient witness fills the adjudicative scale while false believers produce a short measure that returns as their own deficit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant و س م target supplied for focus س م و. It remains visibly anchored by the focus sequence witness, knowing, heavens, and earth; downstream prose should qualify it as a marked-record image rather than derive 'heavens' from 'marking.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ

activation_trace.role: A sign that bears witness allows evidence to reside in visible marks.
A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing joins knowledge to readable traces.
The packet's secondary mapping supplies an overt mark by which something is known.
Reading a mark as evidence supplies the observer's operation.
The lower realm opposite the sky extends the possible record across the whole field.

changed_reading.before: God possesses information about the cosmos and then testifies.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, heavens and earth form a marked evidentiary record whose signs are already present to the all-knowing witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-ayah reversal is surprising because it turns the material covering image of kufr into the shape of consequence. It remains anchored in focus كفر and is activated by the packet's encirclement and over-covering sequence immediately afterward; downstream prose should state it as a rhetorical reversal, not a claim of morphological causation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ... يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the initiating material action.
Encirclement by overpowering destruction reverses the coverer's apparent control.
The same covering branch identifies those now enclosed.
An all-enveloping cover makes the reversal materially explicit.
The upper direction supplies one boundary of total exposure.
The lower direction closes the other boundary, leaving no outside.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is only the agents' act of covering the truth.
changed_reading.after: The sequence reverses the image: those who cover are themselves encircled and over-covered, while the witness's heaven-to-earth knowledge leaves no concealed exterior.

strongest_changes: The opening assay turns belief from a verbal label into a tested attachment discriminated by divine witness.
The spider-house parable makes faith in batil a failed shelter and load-bearing problem.
The book-sufficiency sequence makes God's witness the certification of already-present evidence, not a replacement for evidence.
The 29:67 reprise grounds false belief and covering in misattributed lived security and unacknowledged blessing.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted the focus ayah's abstract contrasts into mechanisms: assay, liability, social bonding, shelter, documentary proof, self-testimony, and security accounting. Distinct readings remain live rather than being merged into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether shahid should be weighted primarily as juridical declaration or direct observational presence.
Whether the liability and commercial-loss imagery is a governing mechanism or a secondary analogy.
Whether 29:67 defines the focus antithesis or supplies one especially concrete instance of it.
The balance and marked-cosmos readings depend on secondary mapped roots and should remain explicitly exploratory.
